_comment: Non-combat NPCs (generated: trainers and lockboxes by tools/gen_classes.py; vendors, bankers and auctioneers by tools/gen_items.py; soulbinders, teleporters and ferries by tools/gen_world.py). Each generator keeps the others' rows. A zone scene's npc markers override x/z/yaw (content/zones/scenes).
